_note: Awards dataset for the txasm awards feature. Definitions for all 13 awards are authored from the vault note awards-content.md. Recipient lists are complete for Faculty Education, Faculty Mentor, and Graduate Student; partial for O.B. Williams (the notable 1971 J.P. Allison entry), Distinguished Service, and Lifetime Achievement; and empty for the eight category-subdivided student awards, whose full recipient histories live on the 13 live txasm.org pages and are filled by running `npm run import:awards -- --parse` (which fetches and parses those pages into this file for review before seeding). awards.name: Thomas S. Matney Award
awards.namesakeBio: Dr. Thomas S. Matney (1928-2010) was a microbiologist and geneticist at UT MD Anderson and the first Associate Dean of the UT Graduate School of Biomedical Sciences.
awards.description: Recognizes the outstanding presentation by a postdoctoral fellow.

awards.name: S.E. Sulkin Award
awards.namesakeBio: Dr. S. Edward Sulkin (1908-1972) was a virologist and Chair of Microbiology at UT Southwestern from 1945 to 1972, known for work on rabies and bats.
awards.description: Outstanding oral presentation of graduate student research in medical microbiology.

awards.name: Sarah A. McIntire Award
awards.namesakeBio: Dr. Sarah A. McIntire (1941-2016) was Professor Emerita at Texas Woman's University, known for work on Helicobacter pylori.
awards.description: Outstanding oral presentation of undergraduate student research.

awards.name: Samuel Kaplan Award
awards.namesakeBio: Dr. Samuel Kaplan (1934-2024) was the founding Chair of Microbiology and Molecular Genetics at UTHealth Houston from 1989 to 2011 and ASM Treasurer from 1991 to 1999.
awards.description: Outstanding poster presentation of graduate student research.

awards.name: O.B. Williams Award
awards.namesakeBio: Dr. Odis Burris (O.B.) Williams (1903-1977) was at UT Austin and served as Texas Branch President from 1943 to 1944.
awards.description: Outstanding oral presentation of graduate student research in general microbiology.

awards.name: Joan Abramowitz Award
awards.namesakeBio: Dr. Joan Abramowitz (1949-2005) chaired Microbiology at the University of Houston-Downtown.
awards.description: Outstanding poster presentation of undergraduate student research.

awards.name: Charlie Gauntt Award
awards.namesakeBio: Dr. Charles J. Gauntt (1937-2015) was a virologist at UT HSC San Antonio and a Texas Branch President.
awards.description: Outstanding oral presentation of graduate student research.

awards.name: Orville Wyss Award
awards.namesakeBio: Dr. Orville Wyss (1912-1993) chaired Microbiology at UT Austin from 1959 to 1969 and served as ASM President from 1964 to 1965.
awards.description: Outstanding poster presentation of undergraduate student research.

awards.name: Graduate Student Award
awards.namesakeBio: The Eugene and Millicent Goldschmidt Graduate Student Award.
awards.description: Recognizes outstanding female graduate students in microbiology.

awards.name: Faculty Education Award
awards.namesakeBio: The Eugene and Millicent Goldschmidt Faculty Education Award.
awards.description: Recognizes faculty excellence in microbiology education.

awards.name: Faculty Mentor Award
awards.namesakeBio: The Eugene and Millicent Goldschmidt Faculty Mentor Award.
awards.description: Recognizes faculty excellence in mentoring microbiology students.

awards.name: Distinguished Service Award
awards.description: Recognizes outstanding, sustained service and leadership advancing the branch mission.

recipients.institution: UT Health Science Center at Houston

awards.name: Lifetime Achievement Award
awards.description: Recognizes exceptional sustained career contributions to microbiology.

recipients.institution: UT Health Science Center at Houston
